svg.title: 青绿莲叶与数学珍珠
svg.desc: Matte champagne pearl and teal Buddhist lotus leaves. 22 exact LaTeX formulas, 88 complete instances. Every mathematical glyph is a vector path. Original PNG is embedded byte-for-byte. Shallow same-material relief. No mirrored or clipped formulas, external fonts, or external resources.
